# Caledonia Heating & Cooling

> Heating and cooling requests for Caledonia. Thermostat repair and replacement covers diagnosing control, sensor, display, and wiring faults and selecting compatible programmable or smart thermostats for heating and cooling equipment.

Email: contact@caledoniaheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://caledoniaheatingcooling.ca

Request locations: Caledonia, Brantford, Paris, Dunnville, Simcoe, Port Dover, Nanticoke, Ayr, Aylmer. Coverage and availability require provider confirmation.
